announcements.step1_desc: This panel shows important announcements from your team or system administrators.
announcements.step2_desc: Each card shows a message with its type (info, warning, or error). Click the × to dismiss it once you have read it.
announcements.step3_desc: As an admin you can post announcements to yourself, specific users, or everyone in your client.

notifications.step1_desc: The red counter shows unread notifications. Click the bell to open the notification center — here you can see all messages with type and timestamp, remove individual entries, or clear all at once.

search.step1_desc: Use the search to instantly find pages, users, files, and other content across the entire system. Just start typing and results appear as you go.
search.step2_desc: Press ⌘K (or Ctrl+K on Windows) from anywhere in the admin to open search without reaching for the mouse. Hold ⌘ to see all available shortcuts.

admin_nav.step1_desc: Use the sidebar to access all administration areas. Click on 'Administration' to manage users, roles, and other settings. Next, we will open the users list.

admin_grid.step1_desc: This overview shows all users. Simply click on any row — the record opens directly for editing.

builder_pages_list.step1_title: Open a page to start the tour
builder_pages_list.step1_desc: Click on any row to open the page in the builder editor. The builder tour will start automatically.

builder_pages.step1_desc: Welcome to the page builder. Here you can visually build and edit the content and layout of this page.
builder_pages.step2_desc: This badge shows whether the page is published, scheduled, or a draft. Click it to publish, schedule, or take the page offline.
builder_pages.step3_desc: Undo or redo your last changes with the arrow buttons. The clock icon opens the full change history for this editing session.
builder_pages.step4_desc: Switch between desktop, tablet, and mobile views to see how your page looks on different screen sizes.
builder_pages.step5_desc: The outline panel shows all rows and components on your page as a tree. Click any item to select it on the canvas.
builder_pages.step6_desc: Use the layout panel to add a new section with 1, 2, 3, or 4 columns. Click a layout to insert it, or drag it onto the canvas.
builder_pages.step7_desc: The components panel lists all available content blocks — headings, images, videos, buttons, and more. Click or drag a component to add it inside a column.
builder_pages.step8_desc: Click any element on the canvas to select it and reveal its properties on the right. Drag the handle on the left of a row to reorder sections.
builder_pages.step9_desc: When an element is selected, its properties appear here. Edit content, change styling, and configure advanced settings. The breadcrumb at the top lets you navigate to parent elements.
builder_pages.step10_desc: Click Save (or press Cmd+S) to save your changes. The dropdown arrow lets you save and close in one step. A pulsing dot indicates unsaved changes.
